scope: Project-local QA of the generated offline dashboard after the row-column fix. No private logs, credentials or tokens included.

browser.rendering: SwiftShader software WebGL/2D; no GPU claims

results.name: detail has model and concrete plan
model value and heuristic range are separate cells
result label distinguishes results from viewport
results.actual: 196 of 758 protocols · 40 official watchlist in results

functional_checks.method: tests/browser-checks.js evaluated via CDP Runtime.evaluate against the real page served from a loopback data-only build

captures.method: Headless Chrome CLI at 1440x900 on a same-origin wrapper page that triggers the same DOM events a user click/keystroke fires (open detail, apply search filter); no compositing, no retouching, no synthetic page state.
captures.source_build: out-check generated by main.ts --data-only from the sealed official snapshot
states: 01-board.jpg: default 196 of 758 candidates, MODEL VALUE DESC
02-detail.jpg: first-row drawer opened by a real click on its row button
03-filtered.jpg: search 'gauntlet' applied through a real input event, 1 of 758
captures.visual_verification: dimensions/byte caps and per-image distinctness checked programmatically; no LLM vision provider was available for a second visual read

notes: Row rendering now emits one cell per declared header (8/8) and TVL is separate from the heuristic range.
The former hard-coded expectation of exactly 7 farm steps was replaced by the documented 3-12 contract after the plan generator legitimately emitted 6 for Gauntlet.
